text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see Nakayama Festa standing at the
classroom
door looking at her
classmates.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm deciding between someone in my
own class or
someone in the next class
over.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Someone in my class, then. In that
case...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Acute. I've got a small favor to ask
you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: And what might that be?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Can you lend me your English and math
notes?
I've got a quiz next week.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
She's normally asleep. Hehe. And she
always
looks so comfortable.
Okay, sure.
You can borrow my notes.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, shut up. Acute said it was fine. I
don't need
your opinion.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's quite all right. With how busy you
are training and racing, I certainly can't
blame you for getting
a little sleepy
during class.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Why shouldn't you prioritize the Twinkle
Series?
I'm exactly the same. We can
help each other out.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
However, I'm not exactly confident how
good my
notes will do.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, what's this mean? "PR.58. ★
Tense Q"?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that means it's related to a practice
question concerning tenses on page
fifty-eight. Filled stars are for related
exercises, and white stars are for 
references.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: And the rest... All of this is just code.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well... I don't write very quickly, so I
made up a
system of shorthand I could
use. It's hard to
understand, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: How about I study together with you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What? No, I just wanna borrow the
notes...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, I need to use the notes too. Don't
you think it'll help us both if we sat
down and had a long,
thorough study
session together?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Fiiine.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Why do you have to involve yourself in
every little thing? Fine, you choose,
then. Should we
start with English or
Math?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
English... Just listening to it puts me to
sleep.
choice_data_list: Math that helps you understand str...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You should try my study method then. It
will get
rid of that sleepiness in an
instant!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute references her notes and
reads aloud the English sentences
written in their textbook while
Nakayama Festa listens along.
Then...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama and Acute
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They do a bit of training while they solve
the
questions. So this is Wonder Acute's
method!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't you normally do something
like this
after getting a question wrong?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But then I wouldn't get enough training. I
originally came up with this method so
that I
wouldn't have to cut down on my
exercise.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's for the best if I want to win in the
Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I know! "He was in a bad mood to begin
with!"
choice_data_list: Question! Why was Stevie so angry?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I got it correct. Now you have to
add
twenty kilograms to your barbell,
Nakayama.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Well, since we made this a
competition...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: And I'll add thirty kilograms to my own.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What? Why? Shouldn't only the loser
get
punished?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, the more weight I carry, the easier
it is to
concentrate. That way I can study
more
effectively.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
All right. Time for the next question.
Let's do a
full squat this time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah! Hahaha! You're out of your mind!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But I'm having fun. So don't think that
I'm about
to fold. Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Flames light up in Nakayama Festa's
eyes. Not
only does she get to prepare
for her quiz, but she
also gets to train!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Leave math to me. Lately, I've
been really
good at predicting what'll be
on the tests.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds so helpful. I'd love for
you to tell
me too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It feels like she is cutting corners,
focusing only on what she expects to
appear on the test. Either way, we
decide to go somewhere we can talk 
more freely.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The next quiz is gonna be on... quadratic

inequalities! I'll even put money on it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So, Acute, were there any points
emphasized
during class?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well... there was that problem about
throwing a ball in the air... Oh, and the
teacher said it had to do with quadratic
functions, so maybe let's take a look at
those.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and this velocity problem, you solve
this
using the quadratic equation too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Guess I should check that then, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Also, since there are a lot of word
problems involving geometry, the
teacher said to look over
geometric
formulas.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...And geometry.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, and according to my notes...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hold up. We basically just reviewed
everything.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Wait, you tricked me... didn't you?
choice_data_list: That was a really productive study...
That was a really productive study...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
I just get so worried if I don't
cover my
bases.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. Goin' along with you helped me
to
understand better how you
meticulous types
think.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Now you're much easier to read.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During the study session, Nakayama
Festa gains a
deeper understanding of
race tactics and
strategy!
